svg.title: Export an encrypted entry backup
svg.desc: An authorized desktop export encrypts entries with a separate backup passphrase, writes a temporary backup, authenticates it before replacement and verifies the final file. Failed final verification must not be treated as a usable backup. Group definitions and vault sign-in credentials are excluded.
